title: Projection off a unit vector lands in the orthogonal complement
statement: Let $V$ be a real inner product space, and let $u,v \in V$ with $\norm{u} = 1$. Then the vector $v - \langle u,v\rangle\, u$ lies in the orthogonal complement $(\mathrm{span}_{\bbr}\{u\})^{\perp}$ of the line spanned by $u$.
hypotheses_covered: V is a real inner product space
v is an arbitrary vector of V
